use_scope: Current-date forward paper research; not a historical policy or live-account approval.
share_policy: Latest disclosed ordinary shares plus reviewed post-basis announcements; fixed future shares, no assumed buybacks, issuance or OCI.
payment_policy: One aggregated dividend at each June-30 forecast year end, first 2027-06-30. Annual effective discounting; fractional first-year time from basis to valuation. Forecast dates are model assumptions, not issuer payment commitments.

sensitivity.no_franchise_tail: Zero future earnings/distributions and no terminal liquidation recovery; extreme total-loss scenario, not an estimated probability or the routine bear price.

rationale.income: FY2025 parent profit fell 4.53%; H1 2026 fell 1.95%, and ex-nonrecurring profit fell 2.04%. The lower TTM anchor removes disclosed exceptional items but is not through-cycle normalized earnings. Five annual -5/0/+5 percent paths represent continued deterioration, stabilization, and an explicitly optimistic recovery, not analyst consensus. They are not calculated by compounding book equity at historical ROE.
rationale.price_event: July's SKU/channel price increases are one-time level changes. Channel weights, volumes and margins are uncertain; no additional whole-company price uplift is stacked onto the profit paths.
rationale.payout: Annual report physical page 33 reports combined distribution including repurchases of 71,153,295,260.53 and repurchases of 6,120,088,960.04; the difference is proposed/interim cash dividends of 65,033,206,300.49, about 79% of annual parent profit. The 75% assumption is a research policy below that observation, not a future company commitment. H1 mother-company CFO 15,224,606,455.02 and capex 828,735,611.53 do not cover dividends/interest paid of 35,032,574,305.20; cash fell from 85,687,080,245.45 to 61,596,625,049.44. Opening cash and subsidiary remittances matter. Consolidated finance-company deposits cannot be treated as distributable cash.
rationale.capital_and_fade: Profit is projected independently for five years; retained earnings increase book capital without automatically earning historic franchise returns. Beginning-equity ROE then fades linearly to the scenario cost of equity over five years. The terminal regime earns its capital cost with growth funded by retention; it contains no perpetual excess franchise value. Five-year horizons are bounded research choices, tested with immediate and ten-year fade, not established forecasts.
rationale.discount: Use the archived CNY sovereign-yield plus listed-equity beta times China total ERP policy. Select central for base and upper/lower for bear/bull. Components are asynchronous dated proxies; the beta interval is not a forward cost-of-equity confidence interval. The +200bp sensitivity tests a materially higher required return; no second country premium is added.
rationale.peer: Wuliangye H1 growth is off restated revenue/profit comparatives; negative operating cash flow and higher sales-expense intensity counter an assumption of automatic industry recovery. Peer growth is not transferred to Moutai.
rationale.time_bridge: The June-30 book basis is a modelling origin using information available only by the actual registration/valuation timestamp. Annual cash-flow values are transported to that valuation timestamp with the matching discount convention; this is not observed September net assets and must never be backfilled into June decisions. June dividends/repurchases already reflected in book equity are not subtracted again.

review_required_before_simulation_admiss: Confirm current model facts, time bridge, payout/capital assumptions and sensitivity results are admissible for the stated paper scope.
Bind the new model and policy to the P1 producer/consumer contracts and daily account; source truth and arithmetic alone do not grant simulation or live admission.
